title: Spec
description: The artifact produced by the intake/spec stages: a concrete, reviewable statement of what will be built. See ADR-0004 and ADR-0003 (spec approval gate).

title.description: Short human-readable title for the work item.

summary.description: A few sentences describing what will change and why.

requirements.description: Discrete, testable statements of required behavior.

open_questions.description: Ambiguities the spec author flagged rather than guessed at. A non-empty list is a signal, not necessarily a blocker.

acceptance_criteria.description: Concrete, checkable conditions that determine when this work is done.
